name: Sanjou Megumi
source: Tomoya’s stepsister — a bright, energetic girl who is rather typical in disliking chores. Super curious about sex and totally down to get frisky with her brother. Has a hint of masochism and sees him as her "gold standard" for men. She’s also pretty possessive and gets jealous easily.
